{{Quote|These shuttles aren’t due to be serviced until the morning. They depart tomorrow afternoon.|Unidentified guard to to Kell Tainer|<ref name="WS" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a guard on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You’re clear to work. Under the eye of a spaceport guard.|Unidentified guard to Kell Tainer|<ref name="WS" />}}
[[File:Kelltainer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Kell Tainer]]
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the guard and his team were assigned to oversee [[Bunker Twenty-two Aleph]] on [[Revos Spaceport]]. The bunker housed the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttles]] ''[[Hawkbat's Perch]]'' and ''[[Hawkbat's Vigil]]''. A [[Plague Group|maintenance team]]&mdash;actually members of the New Republic [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]]&mdash;arrived to service the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] in order to secretly [[Mission to Storinal|infect]] them with [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]]. [[Standard hour/Legends|Hours]] later, a second maintenance team arrived to perform the same work.<ref name="WS" /> 

[[Kell Tainer]], posing as the fake maintenance team's lead [[Unidentified mechanic (Storinal)|mechanic]], attempted to diffuse the situation with the second team's lead mechanic but the latter became aggressive over the potential loss of pay. Tainer suggested that the second mechanic’s team could redo any portions they deemed inadequate without filing a formal complaint, allowing both teams to log hours.<ref name="WS" />

The mechanic considered the offer but ultimately chose to perform the maintenance again and still submit an immediate complaint. A call like that would likely alert the spaceport operators to the unauthorized maintenance job Tainer’s team had just performed, so Tainer provoked the mechanic into a fight and quickly beat him into unconsciousness. He then urged the guard, who witnessed the altercation, to call it in so that Tainer could accuse the mechanic of assault with intent to kill.<ref name="WS" />

The mechanic’s [[Unidentified mechanic's partner (Storinal)|partner]] intervened and asked Tainer not to report the incident. He offered to service the shuttles and refrain from filing a complaint regarding Tainer’s team’s work, arguing that doing so would spare everyone from additional paperwork. The guard agreed to the solution, allowing Tainer’s team to leave the bunker safely with their cover identities intact.<ref name="WS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Fewer reports.|Unidentified guard|<ref name="WS" />}}
The guard was a pragmatic individual who favored solutions that minimized paperwork and unnecessary reporting, viewing “fewer reports” as a desirable outcome.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This guard was a character created by author [[Aaron Allston]] for his novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'', the fifth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] published in [[1998]].<ref name="WS" />
